## 2026--2027 Job Market
I am on the 2026--2027 academic job market and expect to graduate May 2027.
My job market paper is [**"Source Matters: Demand vs. Supply Uncertainty in a Small Open Economy."**](research/jmp/source-matters/index.qmd){.stretched-link}

I am a Ph.D. candidate in Economics at Brown University and a member of the [Global Linkages Lab](https://www.globallinkages.org).
My interests are in macroeconomics, international finance, and macro-finance.
In particular, I study risk and uncertainty and their implications for the macroeconomy and financial markets.
